headline: Produce Buying Company Shareholders Approve GH¢300m Debt Restructuring
summary: Shareholders of Ghana’s Produce Buying Company approved a plan to raise GH¢300 million from the capital market to restructure finances and revive cocoa purchasing operations.
why: Capital-raising and debt restructuring plans are vital for agricultural commodity buyers seeking to maintain liquidity and operational scale.

impacts.name: Produce Buying Company
impacts.why: Debt restructuring provides capital injection for operational revival.
